title: RAW complete f107v.45–49 Galen II.44.2 reading: two preparation goals, different water, and bounded juice retention
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED, NOT SELECTED OR SEMANTICALLY EXECUTED. Complete 49-group ZL3b paragraph assigned36 new fixed whole-form values, five productions and15 explicit binding assumptions, plus optional bridge B16 with four subconditions. A prewritten fallback follows four unfinished <=30-form attempts. Drying uses former-water disposal, immediate transfer of the same food into other HOT water and thorough reboiling until soft; evacuation prohibits thorough boiling and desires as-much-as-possible own-juice retention. The final source-reported capacity limit and qualitative comparative loss are included. The unbridged draft does not separately entail the source aim NOT_LOSE_ALL; an explicit optional feasibility/optimizing-intention bridge supplies that consequence conditionally. Crossed water syntax, contextual liquid ownership, quoted reprise, composite lexemes and alternative-reader gaps remain costs, not confirmed meanings.

exact_section.greek: ξηρᾶναι δ’ ὑγρὰν γαϲτέρα βουληθέντεϲ, ὅταν ἤδη μετρίωϲ ἡψῆϲθαι δοκῇ, τὸ πρότερον ὕδωρ ἀποχέοντεϲ ἐμβαλοῦμεν εὐθέωϲ ἑτέρῳ θερμῷ κἄπειτα πάλιν ἐν ἐκείνῳ καθεψήϲομεν, ὡϲ τακερὰν γενέϲθαι, μὴ καθέψοντεϲ, ὅταν ὑπαγωγῆϲ ἕνεκα λαμβάνηται. βουλόμεθα γὰρ οὐκ ἀποθέϲθαι πάντα τὸν ἴδιον αὐτῆϲ χυλὸν ἐπὶ τῆϲ τοιαύτηϲ χρείαϲ, ἀλλὰ φυλάττειν ὅϲον οἵόν τε μάλιϲτα. τελέωϲ μὲν οὖν φυλάττειν τὸν ἴδιον χυλὸν οὐδὲν τῶν ἑψομένων δύναται, μᾶλλον δ’ ἀποβάλλει τὰ μέχρι πλείονοϲ ἑψηθέντα.
exact_section.english_working_translation: But when wishing to dry a moist belly, once it seems moderately boiled, pouring away the former water we shall immediately put it into other hot water and then boil it thoroughly again in that, so that it becomes soft. We do not boil it thoroughly when it is taken for evacuation. For in that use we wish not to lose all its own juice, but to preserve as much as possible. None of the things being boiled can preserve its own juice completely; those boiled for longer lose more.
exact_section.translation_status: Own source-side semantic translation; not a target reading or certified modern pharmacology.

complete_selected_source.scope: All of II.44.2, including both preparation branches, rationale, inability to retain all own juice and comparative loss. This is not a reading of all five sections of the parent cabbage entry.
complete_selected_source.context: The surrounding source supplies the cabbage topic, portion versus water versus constituent-juice distinction and known transfer-exposure limit. No new source was acquired. The target paragraph has no explicit cabbage lexeme under this draft: that topic assignment is an extra assumption.
complete_selected_source.source_truth: Historical assertions and preparation instructions only; the medical goals do not set a real patient-health state. No modern efficacy or chemistry claim is made.

lexicon.denotation: An agent desires the following purpose or predicate; no achievement entailed.
Drying is the intended medical purpose, not a successful physiological effect.
One compound noun phrase: belly characterized as moist.
Introduces the observation guard; does not assert its satisfaction in an actual patient or cook.
Composite observation predicate on the current food after the first boiling stage. No exact time, temperature or objective degree is measured.
Pour away the selected water; does not silently remove the food or every liquid belonging to it.
Select the former member W0 of this preparation’s water sequence. Its noun argument is position9 across position8.
One composite transfer predicate with an immediacy modifier; its food argument is supplied by the declared topic binding. Immediacy does not prove zero air exposure.
The same water kind at9 and12. FIRST/OTHER create distinct contextual water references; the word itself does not change meaning.
Same IN relation in transfer postcondition and the reboil location; no TO-versus-IN word polysemy.
Introduces W1 distinct from previously selected W0, with the same water kind.

Generic liquid kind. Apposition in C01 resolves it to W1; OWN in C03 and the inherited owner schema in C04/C05 resolve it to the food’s intrinsic juice. This context narrowing is an explicit grammar cost, not a fixed JUICE gloss.
HOT(W1), no numeric temperature or patient state.
Resumes the W1 introduced by OTHER WATER, not W0.
Composite AGAIN + thorough BOIL. Introduces a second boiling event, distinct from the first moderately boiled appearance. Its internal three-part content is counted as a lexical cost.
SOFT is the instructed endpoint; UNTIL does not guarantee eventual reachability.
Same kind at19/38: the current cooked portion at19, a variable of that same kind under NO at38. A new generic binder, not a switch to all objects.
Softness endpoint of the same food; not successful drying or evacuation.
Same relation to a use/purpose at21,29,46. C02 norm, C03 reason and C05 relevance scopes are declared by productions; FOR does not itself create a medical effect.
Same evacuation goal at22/47, resumed by THIS_USE30.
One boiling operation in the C02 prohibition, C03 quoted reprise and C05 duration comparison. Occurrence mode comes from the production, not a new word meaning.
In C02 negates permission for FULLY(BOIL), not all boiling, not the evacuation goal and not the retention desire.

One completion modifier: BOIL has a thorough-preparation endpoint; RETAIN has complete own-juice retention. These two chosen endpoint interpretations are explicit semantic assumptions, not a shared numerical scale.
C03 takes the previously prohibited FULLY BOIL as quoted explanandum and the retention desire as reason.
Resumes the evacuation purpose of C02; no unmarked return to the drying branch.
Same denotation as porain; freely assumed whole-word synonym, counted.
Retain the food’s own intrinsic liquid/juice. Under DESIRE/AS_POSSIBLE this is a goal, not an observed achieved amount.
Qualify the desired extent as as much/as fully as feasible. No numerical optimum, attained maximum or existence of a maximizing physical state is asserted.
Select the food’s intrinsic juice, J(owner), rather than the cooking water merely surrounding that owner.
No member of the stated cooked-food kind can satisfy the following complete-retention capability.
Capability to retain at a given extent. It is not an alias of the DESIRE-governed RETAIN verb at32; final COMPLETELY supplies its extent argument.
Same completion extent as FULLY when applied to retention. Its scope is the embedded retention extent of CAN_RETAIN, not completion of an ability itself. This is one freely assumed lexical synonym.
Compare longer with shorter relevant histories; no minutes or universal unbounded continuous-time law.
Greater own-juice loss in the corresponding history; no fraction or invented measured amount.
Loss of own juice during boiling; the word does not encode a clinical effect.
Connect the final loss comparison to the earlier evacuation policy/rationale; it is not a newly executed cooking step.

whole_paragraph_productions.name: DryingPreparation
whole_paragraph_productions.reading: When wishing to dry a moist belly, once the food seems moderately boiled, discard the first water and immediately transfer that same food into other hot water. Thoroughly boil it again in that water until the cooked food is soft.
whole_paragraph_productions.production: DESIRE DRY MOIST_BELLY WHEN SEEMS_MODERATELY_BOILED DISCARD FIRST IMMEDIATE_TRANSFER WATER IN OTHER WATER LIQUID HOT IN THAT_WATER THOROUGH_REBOIL UNTIL BOILED_FOOD SOFT
bindings: DESIRE1 scopes DRY2(MOIST_BELLY3); WHEN4 scopes the whole disposal/transfer/reboil policy, guarded by the appearance predicate5.

FIRST7 takes WATER9, crossing IMMEDIATE_TRANSFER8. DISCARD6 takes FIRST(WATER)=W0. IMMEDIATE_TRANSFER8 takes the implicit current food P_D, not WATER9. This is a fitted nonprojective dependency, not a proved Voynich grammar.
OTHER11 WATER12 introduces W1!=W0; LIQUID13 HOT14 is an apposition asserting Liquid(W1) and Hot(W1). IN10 supplies the transfer postcondition In(P_D,W1).
IN15 THAT_WATER16 fixes the medium of THOROUGH_REBOIL17 to W1. UNTIL18 BOILED_FOOD19 SOFT20 binds the endpoint Soft(P_D), with19 resuming the same food.

The observation of the first boiling stage E0(P_D,W0) and the prescribed second boiling E1(P_D,W1) remain distinct. The sequence is DISCARD(W0), then IMMEDIATE_TRANSFER(P_D,W1), then THOROUGH_REBOIL(P_D,W1) until Soft(P_D). No second-water disposal is present.

whole_paragraph_productions.name: EvacuationRestriction
whole_paragraph_productions.reading: For evacuation, do not boil thoroughly.
bindings: FOR21 EVACUATION22 establishes the alternative evacuation preparation case E for a portion of the same material kind. It does not impose the second goal on the already processed physical P_D.
BOIL23 NOT24 FULLY25 resolves to PROHIBIT(FULLY(BOIL(P_E))). A different infix negation scope would be a different hypothesis.
This prohibits thorough boiling only; it neither prohibits all boiling nor inserts an unmentioned transfer or a measured shorter duration.

whole_paragraph_productions.name: RetentionRationale
whole_paragraph_productions.reading: Thorough boiling is avoided because in this use one wishes to retain the food’s own liquid as fully as possible.
whole_paragraph_productions.production: FULLY BOIL BECAUSE FOR THIS_USE DESIRE RETAIN FULLY AS_POSSIBLE OWN LIQUID
bindings: FULLY26 BOIL27 quotes the same operation prohibited in C02; BECAUSE28 resumes that prohibition as explanandum. It is not a second imperative to perform the forbidden operation.
FOR29 THIS_USE30 binds the same evacuation purpose E; DESIRE31 introduces its rationale.
RETAIN32 FULLY33 AS_POSSIBLE34 gives a completion-directed retention goal qualified by feasibility, not achieved total retention. OWN35 LIQUID36 selects J(P_E).

Source wording contrasts wishing not to lose all with preserving as much as possible. The draft compresses this into the C03 qualified preservation goal, and B16 explicitly supplies the positive-feasible-option, best-degree and same-juice complement assumptions under which the desired option also avoids total loss. This is extra source-model content, not a measured positive amount. Without B16, the distinct NOT_LOSE_ALL intention is not independently realized by a target token.

representation.source_compression_bridge: B16a–d, stated separately; these imply NOT_LOSE_ALL only inside the intended best-retention content, not as an actually achieved preparation fact.

whole_paragraph_productions.name: UniversalRetentionCapacityLimit
whole_paragraph_productions.reading: No cooked food can retain its own liquid completely.
bindings: NO37 binds X in BOILED_FOOD38, using the same kind as19. Domain is the source’s foods/materials undergoing cooking, not every imaginable object.
CAN_RETAIN39 has extent COMPLETELY41; LIQUID40 is J(X) under the owner-dependent liquid schema introduced by OWN35. It is neither W1 nor one identical physical juice belonging to every X.

The negative statement concerns capability for complete retention, not zero retention. It does not contradict a desire to retain as much as possible or even by itself disprove an unachievable desire for all.

representation.formula: NOT EXISTS X: BOILED_FOOD(X) AND CAN_RETAIN(X,J(X),COMPLETELY)

whole_paragraph_productions.name: ComparativeJuiceLossAndRelevance
whole_paragraph_productions.reading: Longer boiling loses more of the food’s own liquid; therefore this matters for evacuation.
whole_paragraph_productions.production: LONGER MORE LIQUID BOIL FOR EVACUATION LOSE THEREFORE
bindings: LONGER42 modifies the histories of BOIL45; MORE43 modifies the corresponding own-liquid loss LOSE48. LIQUID44 follows the owner-dependent J(X) schema from C03/C04.

FOR46 EVACUATION47 gives the purpose for which the general comparison supplies the rationale. In the main draft it does not restrict the source’s general comparison only to evacuation preparations; that narrower scope is retained as a serious coherent rival.

THEREFORE49 points back to the C02/C03 policy/reason. The source states the comparison qualitatively; no measured minutes, fractions, rate, infinite strict-monotonicity law or necessary clinical outcome is added.

Otherwise matched relevant cooking histories h_short,h_long of the same food kind are the explicit comparison construction. There is no assumed equation identifying FULLY with a particular duration, and the prohibition in C02 is source-written rather than derived from that missing equation.

representation.comparison_context: otherwise matched relevant source cooking histories

continuous_reading: When wishing to dry a moist belly, once the food seems moderately boiled, discard the first water and immediately transfer that same food into other hot water. Thoroughly boil it again in that water until the cooked food is soft. For evacuation, do not boil thoroughly. Thorough boiling is avoided because in this use one wishes to retain the food’s own liquid as fully as possible. No cooked food can retain its own liquid completely. Longer boiling loses more of the food’s own liquid; therefore this matters for evacuation.

fitting_freedom.internal_compound_content_not_free: At least nine deliberately composite values: MOIST_BELLY, SEEMS_MODERATELY_BOILED, IMMEDIATE_TRANSFER, THAT_WATER, THOROUGH_REBOIL, BOILED_FOOD, THIS_USE, AS_POSSIBLE, CAN_RETAIN. These are counted as lexical costs; especially the observation predicate and thorough-reboil verb contain several semantic features. No single value supplies the entire water-replacement instruction, but there is no word-length or morphological derivation of these compounds.
fitting_freedom.selection_freedom: Four preferred drafts and three fallback records inspected; chosen meanings and all five productions were authored after seeing the complete selected target. Recurrence is an internal constraint, not independent training/test separation.
fitting_freedom.binding_assumptions: 15 base assumptions plus1 optional bridge with4 subconditions

new_binding_assumptions.name: Topic, generic agent and portion identity
new_binding_assumptions.content: The parent source supplies CABBAGE as material kind without an overt target cabbage name. One generic agent A and one current food portion per branch are implicit. P_D persists across all C01 physical steps; P_E is a counterpart portion of the same kind, not the same physical object in two simultaneous branches.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Alternative purpose frame
new_binding_assumptions.content: DESIRE DRY opens case D; FOR EVACUATION opens case E. THIS_USE resumes E. These case and reference rules are newly fitted; no unmarked arbitrary case switching elsewhere is allowed.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Crossed former-water dependency
new_binding_assumptions.content: FIRST7 binds WATER9 across TRANSFER8; DISCARD6 consumes W0. TRANSFER8 consumes implicit P_D. This extra dependency is necessary for the main draft and is not established by manuscript structure.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Replacement-water reference and repeated IN
new_binding_assumptions.content: OTHER11 WATER12 introduces W1!=W0; IN10 is the transfer result; THAT_WATER16 resumes W1 as the second IN15/boil medium. No old water is resurrected and no second-water disposal is inserted.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Liquid apposition and ownership narrowing
new_binding_assumptions.content: LIQUID13 apposes W1, OWN35 LIQUID36 selects intrinsic food juice J(P_E), and C04/C05 carry an owner-dependent J(X) schema. Same kind word does not mean same physical liquid. This narrowing is assumed, with a coherent cooking-liquor rival retained.

new_binding_assumptions.name: First observation versus second thorough boil
new_binding_assumptions.content: SEEMS_MODERATELY_BOILED is an appearance after E0; THOROUGH_REBOIL creates distinct E1 in W1. Both compounds and UNTIL-soft endpoint are guessed meanings; observation is not a measured actual state.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Purpose, prohibition and comparison scopes
new_binding_assumptions.content: FOR has one purpose relation but distinct production scopes: C02 prohibition, C03 reason and C05 relevance. NOT scopes FULLY BOIL. C05’s general comparison is not limited only to the stated evacuation purpose in the main variant.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Quoted reprise
new_binding_assumptions.content: FULLY BOIL at26/27 is a quotation of the forbidden operation with inherited prohibition polarity as BECAUSE explanandum. No overt QUOTE word marks this; the fitted C03 construction does. Reading it as an executed imperative is a different candidate.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Shared completion operator
new_binding_assumptions.content: FULLY has the completion-bearing predicate type. BOIL completion means thorough preparation; RETAIN completion means all initial intrinsic juice retained. The axes differ and their endpoint interpretations are chosen. No numerical identity or proof that FULLY always means LONGER is assumed.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Feasibility-qualified desire
new_binding_assumptions.content: AS_POSSIBLE qualifies the completion-directed desired retention. It supplies no achieved amount, numerical maximum or assertion of an attainable optimum. DESIRE is not actual RETAIN.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Source paraphrase of explicit anti-loss intention
new_binding_assumptions.content: The Greek explicitly says wishing not to lose all, but to preserve as much as possible. The target gives one positive feasibility-qualified retention desideratum rather than a separate overt NOT_LOSE_ALL proposition. Its coverage of the negative intention therefore depends on the exact extra bridge B16. Without B16, strict assertion-level source coverage remains a gap; no unseen NOT operator is inserted.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Generic food binder and owner function
new_binding_assumptions.content: NO BOILED_FOOD binds cooked-food X; LIQUID is J(X). This does not generalize to all objects or rebind every X to the same physical portion/juice. CAN_RETAIN, unlike RETAIN, preserves the source capability modality.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Comparative correspondence
new_binding_assumptions.content: LONGER and MORE compare otherwise matched relevant boiling histories with corresponding own-juice loss. The comparison is qualitative and source-reported. No arbitrary numbers, global real-time formula or saturation behavior is supplied.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Endpoint and exposure history
new_binding_assumptions.content: UNTIL states an endpoint instruction, not guaranteed completion. The source-context air/cold-water exposure countercase from II.44.3 is retained; HOT(W1) and IMMEDIATE_TRANSFER do not erase it. This target does not translate that omitted source section.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Goals, claims and explanatory links
new_binding_assumptions.content: DRY and EVACUATION are goals, not achieved health states. BECAUSE/THEREFORE link the retention rationale and policy; they do not create a clinical effect. The claim that this target is about the source at all is unconfirmed.

new_binding_assumptions.name: Explicit positive-feasibility bridge for the anti-total-loss intention
new_binding_assumptions.content: For the evacuation branch alone, assume an admissible preparation set H with at least one positive-own-juice-retention option and a best achievable retention degree. Interpret the C03 desideratum as desiring an option with that best degree. Also bind zero own-juice retention to losing all that same initial own juice. These added conditions make the completion-directed goal include an intended NOT_LOSE_ALL consequence; they assert no actual performed history, measured quantity or successful treatment. Without them the unbridged source-assertion gap remains.

subconditions.statement: The comparison uses one same nonempty initial own-juice object J(P_E) across alternative histories h in nonempty H. Retention degrees r(h) lie in an ordered qualitative scale with least element ZERO and upper bound ALL. ZERO and ALL are endpoint names, not numerical quantities.
There exists h_pos in H with r(h_pos)>ZERO. This positive feasible option is an extra source-model assumption; it is not inferred from the maximization wording or assigned a numerical juice amount.

There exists h_best in H such that r(h_best)>=r(h) for every h in H, AND the optional reading explicitly assigns the agent an intention to choose such a best-retention option. Strict preference alone does not supply this choice intention. Existence of a best degree and the intention to select it are extra assumptions; no actual agent is asserted to execute h_best.

For these same food/juice/history arguments, r(h)=ZERO iff LOSE_ALL(P_E,J(P_E),h). Thus r(h_best)>ZERO entails NOT_LOSE_ALL for the intended best-retention history. This endpoint complement relation is explicit; it is not a chemical mass-conservation equation.

new_binding_assumptions.conditional_derivation: B16b and B16c give r(h_best)>=r(h_pos)>ZERO. With B16d the desired best-retention option does not lose all own juice. The source-reported C04 inability to retain ALL, if applied to these cooked-food histories, additionally bounds that desired degree below ALL. No numerical intermediate degree, realized amount, clinical effect or temporal boiling threshold follows.
new_binding_assumptions.scope_limit: B16 is not imposed on the drying branch, all source foods, every imaginable feasible history or the unchanged parent cards. If a reviewer rejects B16, record the explicit anti-total-loss-intention gap without changing any of the36 values or inserting a NOT token.

shared_inputs_and_distinct_consequences.binding: FIRST(WATER)=W0 and OTHER(WATER)=W1; repeated IN relates the same P_D to W1 after transfer and during E1.
shared_inputs_and_distinct_consequences.different_consequences: W0 is discarded; W1 is the retained reference for second boiling. Rebinding THAT_WATER to W0 changes the prescribed physical medium after disposal.
shared_inputs_and_distinct_consequences.limit: FIRST, OTHER, THAT_WATER and crossed attachment are newly guessed singletons; two WATER tokens alone do not prove water identity or this story.

shared_inputs_and_distinct_consequences.binding: The same FULLY(BOIL) appears under C02 prohibition and C03 quotation; FULLY also modifies RETAIN in the desire. C05 uses that same BOIL in a qualitative duration comparison.
shared_inputs_and_distinct_consequences.different_consequences: A prohibition blocks performing the thorough operation in E; its mention in a reason does not perform it. The retention desire does not assert complete retention and thus remains distinct from C04’s inability to retain all.
shared_inputs_and_distinct_consequences.limit: The quotation scope and completion-axis endpoints are assumed. C02/C03 repeat a proposition rather than two independent semantic observations; this is not evidence of two independently tested operator cells.

shared_inputs_and_distinct_consequences.binding: The liquid kind has W1 as appositive referent at13, J(P_E) under OWN36, and J(X) under generic food ownership40/44. BOILED_FOOD keeps one kind with current versus quantified binding.
shared_inputs_and_distinct_consequences.different_consequences: HOT applies to the replacement water, complete-retention incapacity and comparative loss to the food’s own juice. The main model does not infer complete water disposal from own-juice loss, nor identify every food’s juice.

strongest_prior_countercases: RAW402 owns all five Galen sections; RAW482 fixes persistent air/cold-water exposure through later hot boiling. This smaller II.44.2 target account does not claim those broader target bindings are solved or remove those source conditions.
HOT replacement water does not reset transfer exposure. An instruction UNTIL SOFT can lack a reachable endpoint after the prohibited exposure described in II.44.3; no actual success is inferred.
The source does not order disposal of the second water, supply retention fractions or guarantee a clinical effect. No such event or output appears in this draft.
The parent source limits vision with an abnormal-moist-eye exception and leaves urination epistemically uncertain; neither is translated or replaced by a positive/zero-health claim here.

W89’s recipe/description comparison is paused and does not confirm English operations. Its old five predicates and failed material/reference matches are not repaired by this independent dictionary. W94’s quantity/ratio alternatives likewise remain old incompatible values, including daiin as a mass/ratio role instead of new BECAUSE.
The exact f107v paragraph was already exposed in W80/W82/W89/W94 whole-paragraph readings. Their mostly unknown material/quantity projections do not supply independent support for this Galen account.

All36 values and five productions are fitted after target inspection. Twenty-eight singleton forms and composite lexemes leave high content freedom. The repeated forms constrain internal uniformity, not historical correctness.

C03’s positive retention desideratum does not alone ensure a NOT_LOSE_ALL intention: an all-zero feasible set is a real logical counterexample. The base version retains that source-goal gap. The optional conditional version adds B16a–d plus an explicit intention to choose a best option. Strict preference alone does not establish such a selected intention, nor is maximizer existence automatic. No positive quantity is measured, source-proved or actually achieved.
The full IT2a paragraph has51 groups and different word boundaries/readings. The frozen36-value ZL account is not a full literal IT2a reading; no alternative is smoothed to rescue it.
